description.value: Cook Street Liquor is an independently owned bottle shop established in 2008, now anchored at 304 Cook Street in the heart of Victoria's Cook Street Village. It carries a carefully curated mix of local and international wines, craft beers, and spirits alongside flowers, artisan cheeses, and local charcuterie. A loyalty program, online ordering with free in-store pickup, and free local delivery round out the offer for visitors stocking up.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 42m; staple (4 spaces) at 73m; staple (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, open, independently owned liquor store at 304 Cook Street, Victoria BC, with phone 250-995-2665, corroborating the OSM address. The website mentions in-store pickup and local delivery, and describes a selection of beverages, flowers, cheese, and charcuterie. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities is found on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-995-2665 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text rather than real legal content, suggesting the website may be partially under construction, though the rest of the site appears fully operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible independent liquor store in a busy Victoria neighbourhood. Useful stop for touring cyclists resupplying.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag atm=yes suggests an in-store ATM; not confirmed or denied on the website. A second sister location (Borden St. Liquor, 4025 Borden St) is referenced on the website but is a separate business.

wow_evidence: independently owned bottle shop established in 2008
